---
title: "The center of film"
format:
  closeread-html:
    remove-header-space: true
    embed-resources: true
    cr-style:
      section-background-color: "#DCDFE2"
      narrative-text-color-overlay: "#1E1E1E"
      narrative-overlay-max-width: "clamp(240px, 26vw, 380px)"
      narrative-font-size: "clamp(0.9rem, 1.2vw, 1.1rem)"
      narrative-font-family: "'Newsreader', Georgia, serif"
---

```{=html}
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,600;1,6..72,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@300;400;600&display=swap');

:root {
  --base: #DCDFE2;
  --card: rgba(240, 242, 243, 0.96);
  --pencil: #4A4E53;
  --accent: #C8102E;
  --ink: #1E1E1E;
  --muted: #5E6368;
  --mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
}

html, body { background: var(--base); }

/* Hand-drawn frames: each box sits on a pseudo-element bent by one of the wobble filters below */
.cr-section .narrative-col .narrative {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  background: transparent !important;
  padding: 0.6em 0.8em !important;
}
.cr-section .narrative-col .narrative::before,
.top-panel::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1.6px solid var(--pencil);
  border-radius: 4px;
  filter: url(#wobble-1);
}
.cr-section .narrative-col > :nth-child(3n + 2) .narrative::before,
.top-panel::before { filter: url(#wobble-2); }
.cr-section .narrative-col > :nth-child(3n) .narrative::before { filter: url(#wobble-3); }

/* Labels in monospace capitals */
.cr-title-h1, .cr-title-sub, .cr-hint, .cr-period, .cr-stop {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.cr-title-h1 { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
.cr-title-sub { color: var(--accent); font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 0.9vw, 0.85rem); }
.cr-hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.7rem; margin-top: 1.4rem; }
.cr-period { color: var(--accent); font-size: 0.8em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.cr-stop { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.75em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }

/* Card body */
.cr-section a, .cr-section a:visited { color: var(--accent); }
.cr-p { display: block; height: 0.7em; }
.cr-photo { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; object-fit: cover; margin: 0.2rem 0 0.25rem; filter: grayscale(0.25); }
.cr-credit, .cr-colophon { display: block; color: var(--muted); }
.cr-credit { font-size: 0.65rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
.cr-colophon { font-size: 0.95em; }
.cr-credit a, .cr-credit a:visited { color: var(--muted); }

/* Top places panel, fixed at the lower right */
.top-panel {
  position: fixed;
  right: 1.5rem;
  bottom: 1.5rem;
  z-index: 0;
  isolation: isolate;
  width: clamp(220px, 22vw, 320px);
  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.4s;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.top-panel.show { opacity: 1; }
.tp-title { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.66rem; margin-bottom: 0.45rem; }
.tp-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9.5em 1fr 2.8em; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; margin: 0.2rem 0; }
.tp-name { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.tp-bar { display: block; height: 8px; }
.tp-n { text-align: right; }
</style>

<svg width="0" height="0" style="position: absolute" aria-hidden="true">
  <filter id="wobble-1" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.025" numOctaves="2" seed="3"/><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" scale="6"/></filter>
  <filter id="wobble-2" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.025" numOctaves="2" seed="11"/><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" scale="6"/></filter>
  <filter id="wobble-3" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.025" numOctaves="2" seed="27"/><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" scale="6"/></filter>
</svg>
```

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)

base_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-11-24/"
read_tt <- \(file) read_csv(str_c(base_url, file, ".csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

locations <- read_tt("locations")
production_locations <- read_tt("production_locations")
productions <- read_tt("productions")

periods <- tibble(
  period = 1:7,
  label = c("Before 1920", "1920–1945", "1946–1959", "1960–1975", "1976–1999", "2000–2012", "2013–"),
  start = c(-Inf, 1920, 1946, 1960, 1976, 2000, 2013)
)

# One row per title and filming location
links <- production_locations |>
  left_join(productions, by = join_by(production_id)) |>
  left_join(locations, by = join_by(location_id)) |>
  filter(!is.na(year)) |>
  mutate(
    period = findInterval(year, periods$start),
    decade = pmax(year %/% 10 * 10, 1900),
    continent = countrycode::countrycode(country_code, "iso2c", "continent", warn = FALSE),
    other = !(country_code %in% c("US", "CA") | continent %in% "Europe")
  )

# Average on the globe: mean of the 3D unit vectors, projected back to lon/lat
spherical_mean <- function(df, by) {
  rad <- pi / 180
  df |>
    mutate(
      x = cos(latitude * rad) * cos(longitude * rad),
      y = cos(latitude * rad) * sin(longitude * rad),
      z = sin(latitude * rad)
    ) |>
    summarise(across(c(x, y, z), mean), .by = {{ by }}) |>
    mutate(lon = atan2(y, x) / rad, lat = atan2(z, sqrt(x^2 + y^2)) / rad) |>
    select({{ by }}, lon, lat) |>
    arrange({{ by }})
}

centroids <- links |>
  spherical_mean(period) |>
  left_join(periods, by = join_by(period))

decades <- spherical_mean(links, decade)

places <- count(links, period, location_id, other, lon = longitude, lat = latitude)

top_places <- links |>
  count(period, name, other) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 5, by = period, with_ties = FALSE)

# Stops outside North America and Europe, keyed by Wikidata ID
stops <- tribble(
  ~id,         ~location_id, ~period,
  "baku",      "Q9248",      1,
  "hong_kong", "Q8646",      5,
  "ooty",      "Q9888",      5,
  "sydney",    "Q3130",      6,
  "wadi_rum",  "Q40729",     7,
  "istanbul",  "Q406",       7
) |>
  left_join(
    select(locations, location_id, name, lon = longitude, lat = latitude),
    by = join_by(location_id)
  ) |>
  left_join(count(links, location_id, period), by = join_by(location_id, period))

# Numbers quoted in the text
n_titles <- n_distinct(links$production_id)
titles_by_period <- links |> distinct(period, production_id) |> count(period) |> pull(n)
share_other <- links |> summarise(share = mean(other), .by = period) |> arrange(period) |> pull(share)
istanbul_tv <- links |> filter(location_id == "Q406", period == 7) |> summarise(mean(kind == "tv")) |> pull()

fmt <- \(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
pct <- \(x) str_c(round(100 * x), "%")
n_stop <- \(s) stops$n[stops$id == s]

# Card photos from Wikimedia Commons, with credits
commons <- \(file, license) str_glue("[{license}](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:{file})")

photos <- tribble(
  ~id,            ~file,                     ~credit,
  "fort_lee",     "p1_fort_lee.jpg",         "Selznick Studio, Fort Lee, 1920. Public domain",
  "baku",         "baku.jpg",                "Still from *The Oil Gush in Balakhany* (1898), Alexandre Michon. Public domain",
  "hollywood",    "p2_hollywood.jpg",        "Hollywood studios from the air, 1922. Public domain",
  "pinewood",     "p3_pinewood.jpg",         str_c("Pinewood Studios. Photo: Shazz, ", commons("Entrance_to_Pinewood_Studios_-_geograph.org.uk_-_3470583.jpg", "CC BY-SA 2.0")),
  "pinewood_lot", "p4_pinewood_backlot.jpg", str_c("A set on the Pinewood back lot. Photo: Alexander P Kapp, ", commons("Back-lot_in_Pinewood_Studios_-_geograph.org.uk_-_3195288.jpg", "CC BY-SA 2.0")),
  "new_york",     "p5_new_york.jpg",         "Queensboro Bridge, New York, 1974. Photo: Danny Lyon, Documerica. Public domain",
  "hong_kong",    "hong_kong.jpg",           str_c("Photo: Mustang Joe, ", commons("Hong_Kong_from_Victoria_Peak1.jpg", "CC0")),
  "ooty",         "ooty.jpg",                str_c("Photo: Hemant meena, ", commons("Ooty_aerial_view.JPG", "CC BY-SA 3.0")),
  "la_hills",     "p6_los_angeles.jpg",      str_c("Los Angeles from the Hollywood Hills. Photo: Blake Everett, ", commons("Hollywood,_Los_Angeles,_CA_03.JPG", "CC0")),
  "sydney",       "sydney.jpg",              str_c("Photo: W. Bulach, ", commons("00_3178_Sydney,_Australia.jpg", "CC BY-SA 4.0")),
  "la_night",     "p7_los_angeles.jpg",      str_c("Downtown Los Angeles. Photo: Sevan Seviant, ", commons("Hot_Nights_Bright_Lights_The_Sunsets_In_Los_Angeles_(41335116).jpeg", "CC BY 3.0")),
  "wadi_rum",     "wadi_rum.jpg",            str_c("Photo: Raya Sharbain, ", commons("Wadi_Rum_in_December.jpg", "CC BY-SA 4.0")),
  "istanbul",     "istanbul.jpg",            str_c("Photo: Hunanuk, ", commons("Historical_peninsula_and_modern_skyline_of_Istanbul.jpg", "CC0"))
)

photo <- function(id) {
  p <- photos[photos$id == id, ]
  str_glue('<img class="cr-photo" src="images/{p$file}" alt=""><span class="cr-credit">{p$credit}</span>')
}

ojs_define(
  places_data = places,
  centroid_data = select(centroids, period, label, lon, lat),
  decade_data = decades,
  stop_data = select(stops, id, name, lon, lat),
  top_data = top_places
)
```

:::{.cr-section layout="overlay-left"}

:::{#cr-map style="width:100%; height:100svh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; box-sizing:border-box;"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
topojson = require("topojson-client@3")
world = fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/land-110m.json").then(r => r.json())
land = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.land)

// Palette and type
accent = "#C8102E"          // averages, trails and stop rings
placeColor = "#1B6E80"      // filming locations
elsewhereColor = "#D4930D"  // locations outside North America and Europe
ink = "#1E1E1E"
paper = "#ECEEF0"
graphite = "#4A4E53"
mono = "'IBM Plex Mono', monospace"

size = Math.min(width || 800, 860)
home = [-40, 50]
moveMs = 1400

proj = d3.geoOrthographic()
  .rotate([-home[0], -home[1]])
  .fitExtent([[10, 10], [size - 10, size - 10]], {type: "Sphere"})

geoPath = d3.geoPath(proj)

places = transpose(places_data)
cents = transpose(centroid_data)
decs = transpose(decade_data)
tops = transpose(top_data)
stopsById = new Map(transpose(stop_data).map(s => [s.id, s]))

// One entry per trigger in the section, in document order
steps = [
  {kind: "title"},
  {kind: "intro"},
  {kind: "period", period: 1},
  {kind: "stop", period: 1, stop: "baku"},
  {kind: "period", period: 2},
  {kind: "period", period: 3},
  {kind: "period", period: 4},
  {kind: "period", period: 5},
  {kind: "stop", period: 5, stop: "hong_kong"},
  {kind: "stop", period: 5, stop: "ooty"},
  {kind: "period", period: 6},
  {kind: "stop", period: 6, stop: "sydney"},
  {kind: "period", period: 7},
  {kind: "stop", period: 7, stop: "wadi_rum"},
  {kind: "stop", period: 7, stop: "istanbul"},
  {kind: "decades"},
  {kind: "elsewhere", center: [50, 20]},
  {kind: "end"}
]

step = steps[Math.min(crTriggerIndex ?? 0, steps.length - 1)]
period = step.period ?? null
stop = step.stop ? stopsById.get(step.stop) : null

// State kept across steps: where the moving average sits, and the running comet
view = ({pos: null, comet: null})

lonLat = d => [d.lon, d.lat]
line = coordinates => geoPath({type: "LineString", coordinates})
targetOf = s => s.center ?? (s.stop ? lonLat(stopsById.get(s.stop)) : home)
radius = d3.scaleSqrt().domain([1, d3.max(places, d => d.n)]).range([2, 12])

front = d => {
  const [lambda, phi] = proj.rotate()
  return d3.geoDistance(lonLat(d), [-lambda, -phi]) < Math.PI / 2
}

// Move marks to their projected position and hide those on the far side
pin = sel => sel
  .attr("transform", d => `translate(${proj(lonLat(d))})`)
  .attr("display", d => front(d) ? null : "none")

// Map labels in monospace with a paper halo
halo = sel => sel
  .attr("font-family", mono).attr("fill", ink)
  .attr("paint-order", "stroke").attr("stroke", paper).attr("stroke-width", 3)

mapSvg = {
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("width", size).attr("height", size).style("display", "block")
  const defs = svg.append("defs")

  // Pencil wobble: strong on the base map, light on trails and rings
  const wobble = (id, scale) => {
    const f = defs.append("filter").attr("id", id)
      .attr("x", "-5%").attr("y", "-5%").attr("width", "110%").attr("height", "110%")
    f.append("feTurbulence").attr("type", "fractalNoise").attr("baseFrequency", 0.03).attr("numOctaves", 2).attr("seed", 1)
    f.append("feDisplacementMap").attr("in", "SourceGraphic").attr("scale", scale)
  }
  wobble("boil", 9)
  wobble("sketch", 3)

  // Diagonal pencil hatching for land
  defs.append("pattern").attr("id", "hatch").attr("width", 5).attr("height", 5)
    .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse").attr("patternTransform", "rotate(40)")
    .append("line").attr("x2", 0).attr("y2", 5)
    .attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 0.9).attr("stroke-opacity", 0.55)

  const base = svg.append("g").attr("filter", "url(#boil)")
  base.append("path").attr("class", "geo").datum({type: "Sphere"})
    .attr("fill", paper).attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 1.4)
  base.append("path").attr("class", "geo").datum(d3.geoGraticule10())
    .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 0.4).attr("stroke-opacity", 0.35)
  base.append("path").attr("class", "geo").datum(land)
    .attr("fill", "url(#hatch)").attr("stroke", graphite).attr("stroke-width", 1)

  // Layers, bottom to top
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "places")
  svg.append("path").attr("class", "trail").attr("filter", "url(#sketch)")
    .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 2).attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
  svg.append("path").attr("class", "dec-trail").attr("filter", "url(#sketch)")
    .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 1.5).attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "comet").attr("filter", "url(#sketch)")
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "decs")
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "cents")
  svg.append("g").attr("class", "stops")
  return svg.node()
}

// Line boil: a new noise seed every 300 ms
_boil = {
  const turb = d3.select(mapSvg).selectAll("feTurbulence")
  const timer = d3.interval(() => turb.attr("seed", () => 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)), 300)
  invalidation.then(() => timer.stop())
}

// Filming locations change with the step only
_places = {
  const kind = step.kind
  const shown = kind === "intro" ? places
    : kind === "elsewhere" ? places.filter(d => d.other)
    : period ? places.filter(d => d.period === period) : []
  d3.select(mapSvg).select(".places").selectAll("circle")
    .data(shown, d => `${d.period}|${d.location_id}`)
    .join(
      enter => enter.append("circle")
        .attr("r", 0).attr("fill-opacity", 0.6)
        .call(e => e.transition().duration(500).attr("r", d => radius(d.n))),
      update => update,
      exit => exit.call(e => e.transition().duration(300).attr("r", 0).remove())
    )
    .attr("fill", kind === "elsewhere" ? elsewhereColor : placeColor)
    .call(pin)
}

// Each step turns the globe and slides the average over moveMs, whatever the scroll speed
_view = {
  const svg = d3.select(mapSvg)
  const trail = svg.select("path.trail")
  const done = step.kind === "end"
  const p = done ? cents.length : (period ?? 0)
  const past = cents.filter(c => c.period < p)
  const goal = p >= 1 ? lonLat(cents[p - 1]) : null
  const from = view.pos ?? goal
  const posAt = from && goal ? d3.geoInterpolate(from, goal) : () => goal

  // Turn the shorter way round
  const r0 = proj.rotate().slice(0, 2)
  const to = targetOf(step)
  const r1 = [r0[0] + ((((-to[0] - r0[0]) % 360) + 540) % 360) - 180, -to[1]]
  const rotAt = d3.interpolate(r0, r1)

  const draw = k => {
    proj.rotate(rotAt(k))
    svg.selectAll("path.geo").attr("d", geoPath)
    svg.selectAll(".places circle").call(pin)

    const pos = view.pos = posAt(k)
    trail.attr("d", pos ? line([...past.map(lonLat), pos]) : null)

    // Period averages: past ones small, the current one large and labelled
    const marks = [
      ...past.map(c => ({...c, current: false})),
      ...(pos ? [{...cents[p - 1], lon: pos[0], lat: pos[1], current: !done}] : [])
    ]
    svg.select(".cents").selectAll("g.cent")
      .data(marks, d => d.period)
      .join(enter => {
        const g = enter.append("g").attr("class", "cent")
        g.append("circle").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
        g.append("text").attr("x", 12).attr("y", 4).call(halo)
        return g
      })
      .call(pin)
      .each(function(d) {
        const g = d3.select(this)
        g.select("circle").attr("r", d.current ? 8 : 4).attr("fill", d.current ? accent : paper)
        g.select("text")
          .text(d.current || done ? d.label : "")
          .attr("font-size", d.current ? 15 : 11)
          .attr("font-weight", d.current ? 600 : 400)
      })

    // Decade averages, drawn one after another
    const shownDecs = step.kind === "decades" ? decs.slice(0, Math.ceil(k * decs.length)) : []
    const labelled = new Set([1900, 1910, 1960, 1990, 2020])
    svg.select("path.dec-trail").attr("d", shownDecs.length > 1 ? line(shownDecs.map(lonLat)) : null)
    svg.select(".decs").selectAll("g.dec")
      .data(shownDecs, d => d.decade)
      .join(enter => {
        const g = enter.append("g").attr("class", "dec")
        g.append("circle").attr("r", 3.5).attr("fill", paper).attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 1.2)
        g.append("text")
          .text(d => labelled.has(d.decade) ? `${d.decade}s` : "")
          .attr("x", 8).attr("y", 4).attr("font-size", 12).call(halo)
        return g
      })
      .call(pin)

    // Stop ring fades in as the globe arrives
    svg.select(".stops").selectAll("g.stop")
      .data(stop ? [stop] : [], d => d.id)
      .join(enter => {
        const g = enter.append("g").attr("class", "stop")
        g.append("circle").attr("r", 15).attr("fill", "none")
          .attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 2.2).attr("filter", "url(#sketch)")
        g.append("text").text(d => d.name)
          .attr("x", 20).attr("y", 5).attr("font-size", 15).attr("font-weight", 600).call(halo)
        return g
      })
      .call(pin)
      .attr("opacity", k)
  }

  // Clear the comet from the final step
  view.comet?.stop()
  svg.select(".comet").selectAll("path").remove()
  svg.select(".cents").selectAll("g.cent").attr("opacity", null)
  trail.attr("stroke-opacity", null)

  svg.interrupt("move")
  draw(0)
  const move = svg.transition("move").duration(moveMs).ease(d3.easeCubicInOut).tween("move", () => draw)

  // Final step: a comet runs along the dimmed trail at a steady speed and repeats.
  // Ten stacked dashes of growing length end at the head, so overlap is densest there.
  if (done) move.on("end", () => {
    const len = trail.node().getTotalLength()
    const tail = len * 0.35
    const dur = 7000
    const pause = 900
    trail.attr("stroke-opacity", 0.25)

    const comet = svg.select(".comet").selectAll("path")
      .data(d3.range(1, 11).map(i => i / 10))
      .join("path")
      .attr("d", trail.attr("d"))
      .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", accent).attr("stroke-width", 3)
      .attr("stroke-linecap", "round").attr("stroke-opacity", 0.2)
      .attr("stroke-dasharray", f => `${tail * f} ${len + tail}`)

    // Distance along the trail to each period's average, measured on prefixes of the same line
    const pts = cents.map(lonLat)
    const probe = svg.append("path")
    const at = pts.map((_, i) => i === 0 ? 0 : probe.attr("d", line(pts.slice(0, i + 1))).node().getTotalLength())
    probe.remove()

    // Each period lights up as the head reaches it and fades with the tail
    const marks = svg.select(".cents").selectAll("g.cent")
    const glow = k => k < 0 || k > tail ? 0.25 : 1 - 0.75 * k / tail

    view.comet = d3.timer(elapsed => {
      const head = Math.min((elapsed % (dur + pause)) / dur, 1) * (len + tail)
      comet.attr("stroke-dashoffset", f => tail * f - head)
      marks.attr("opacity", d => glow(head - at[d.period - 1]))
    })
  })
}

// Top five places for the current period, in a fixed panel at the lower right
topPanel = {
  const el = htl.html`<div class="top-panel" aria-live="polite"></div>`
  document.body.appendChild(el)
  invalidation.then(() => el.remove())
  return {el}
}

_top = {
  const el = topPanel.el
  if (!period) return el.classList.remove("show")
  const rows = tops.filter(d => d.period === period)
  const max = d3.max(rows, d => d.n)
  el.replaceChildren(
    htl.html`<div class="tp-title">Most titles ▸ ${cents[period - 1].label}</div>`,
    ...rows.map(d => htl.html`<div class="tp-row">
      <span class="tp-name">${d.name}</span>
      <span><span class="tp-bar" style="width: ${100 * d.n / max}%; background: ${d.other ? elsewhereColor : placeColor}"></span></span>
      <span class="tp-n">${d.n.toLocaleString("en-US")}</span>
    </div>`)
  )
  el.classList.add("show")
}

// Display the map
chart = mapSvg
```
:::

<span class="cr-title-h1">The<br>**center**<br>of<br>film</span><span class="cr-title-sub">Following the average filming location since 1887</span><span class="cr-hint">Scroll, or use the arrow keys</span> [@cr-map]

Wikidata knows where `r fmt(n_titles)` movies and TV shows were filmed. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">01 ▸ Before 1920 ▸ `r fmt(titles_by_period[1])` titles</span>`r photo("fort_lee")`The red dot is the average of each period's locations, measured on the globe.<span class="cr-p"></span>Fort Lee, New Jersey, just across the Hudson, beats New York. Hollywood comes later. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Baku, Azerbaijan</span>`r photo("baku")`Nowhere outside North America and Europe has more early films. Two of its `r n_stop("baku")`, both from 1898, show oil gushers. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">02 ▸ 1920–1945 ▸ `r fmt(titles_by_period[2])` titles</span>`r photo("hollywood")`Los Angeles takes over. Studios near London and in Berlin pull the average north-east, over Greenland. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">03 ▸ 1946–1959 ▸ `r fmt(titles_by_period[3])` titles</span>`r photo("pinewood")`Pinewood Studios, west of London, beats every city. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">04 ▸ 1960–1975 ▸ `r fmt(titles_by_period[4])` titles</span>`r photo("pinewood_lot")`Pinewood, home of the early Bond films, still leads.<span class="cr-p"></span>The average reaches its easternmost point, just north of Ireland. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">05 ▸ 1976–1999 ▸ `r fmt(titles_by_period[5])` titles</span>`r photo("new_york")`Los Angeles and New York lead again, and the average moves back west. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Hong Kong</span>`r photo("hong_kong")`*Police Story*, *Chungking Express* and `r n_stop("hong_kong") - 2` more. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Ooty, India</span>`r photo("ooty")`A hill station in Tamil Nadu, and a favorite of Indian cinema. *Roja* and *Kuch Kuch Hota Hai* were both shot here. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">06 ▸ 2000–2012 ▸ `r fmt(titles_by_period[6])` titles</span>`r photo("la_hills")`Los Angeles still leads, and the average barely moves. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Sydney, Australia</span>`r photo("sydney")`Two Star Wars prequels and both Matrix sequels were shot here. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-period">07 ▸ 2013– ▸ `r fmt(titles_by_period[7])` titles</span>`r photo("la_night")`The average moves east again, to a point south of Iceland. Los Angeles is still on top. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Wadi Rum, Jordan</span>`r photo("wadi_rum")`The desert stood in for Mars in *The Martian* and for Arrakis in *Dune*. [@cr-map]

<span class="cr-stop">Stop ▸ Istanbul, Turkey</span>`r photo("istanbul")`Turkish TV drama is watched from Latin America to the Middle East, and much of it is shot here.<span class="cr-p"></span>`r pct(istanbul_tv)` of Istanbul's `r n_stop("istanbul")` titles since 2013 are series. [@cr-map]

Split by decade, the average goes west in the 1910s, east by the 1960s, west again in the 1990s and back east since. [@cr-map]

Every place outside North America and Europe, all periods together.<span class="cr-p"></span>Their share of locations grew from `r pct(share_other[1])` before 1920 to `r pct(share_other[7])` since 2013, not enough to pull the average off the North Atlantic. [@cr-map]

:::{focus-on="cr-map"}
All seven averages together.

<span class="cr-colophon">Places on the far side of the globe are hidden but count toward each average.<span class="cr-p"></span>Data from Wikidata via [Movie Scene Map](https://moviescenemap.com/data/).<span class="cr-p"></span>Made by [Georgios Karamanis](https://karaman.is) with [Closeread](https://closeread.netlify.app).</span>
